purpose: Public source pins and reproducible build configuration; no machine-specific binary identity or build result is recorded here

integrity.pgp_reason: Release archive detached signature verified on 2026-09-11 with GnuPG 2.4.4 against the pinned public key bundle. The signing subkey is certified by the primary fingerprint published on the official OpenSSL source page; no Web-of-Trust certification is claimed.

build_configuration.target_selection: Select the documented OpenSSL Configure target for the intended OS, architecture and compiler; darwin64-arm64-cc is the macOS ARM64 example
build_configuration.prefix_notation: ${REPO_ROOT} is the project checkout chosen by the builder; ${OPENSSL_TARGET} is the intended OpenSSL build target
build_configuration.install_method: Stage generated public headers, the static crypto library and LICENSE.txt under the repository-local prefix; no global installation is required

validation_procedure.archive_review: Before extraction, require the expected top-level prefix and reject absolute/traversal paths, links and special/device entries
validation_procedure.build_plan_review: Review Configure, configuration helpers, target templates and generated commands before execution; check for unexpected downloads, services or privileged/system installation
validation_procedure.nist_reference: NIST SP 800-38A sections F.5.1 and F.5.5, four-block AES-128-CTR and AES-256-CTR published vectors
validation_procedure.linkage_review: Inspect the resulting binary dependencies using the target platform tools; record build and test outcomes separately
scope_limitations: Build instructions and source pins do not establish successful validation on any particular target
The no-apps/no-tests configuration omits the upstream full test suite
A bounded build-path review and primitive smoke tests are not a comprehensive source security audit or FIPS validation
Application protocol and integration tests are separate from primitive validation
